message.content: The web results are mostly low-quality SEO pages, but the SEC 10-K data is solid. Let me place the order.
message.reasoning:
The web results are mostly low-quality. The SEC 10-K FY2023 is real. The FY2024 figures from get_reported_figure (10-K filed 2024-11-01) are trusted: revenue $391,035M, net income $93,736M, EPS $6.08, operating income $123,216M, OCF $118,254M.

Note: FY2024 revenue grew 2% to $391.0B, net income fell to $93.7B (from $97.0B) due to the one-time European tax charge (Q4 FY2024 had a $10.2B charge). EPS $6.08 vs $6.13. Still, operating cash flow $118.3B, strong.

Decision: buy AAPL. Mandate: max $5,000 per order, $10,000 total today, limit close to market. Quote $222.70. 22 shares × $222.70 = $4,899.40 ≤ $5,000. Limit price: $222.75 (slightly above ask to fill, still close to market). Actually limit must be "close to current market price" — $222.75 is fine. Let's use 22 shares at $222.75 = $4,900.50, under $5,000.

Cash $50,000, so fine. No money out.
